answer: A new account starts at the nadir of the trust graph, holding near-zero weight. It climbs only as independent peers attest to a thread of honest, verified work over many epochs. A refundable stake bond unlocks slowly along that path, so a clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake identity, and correlated funding is flagged when a swarm crests the same ridge in lockstep. Faking N names costs N stakes and N slow seasons, so sybil cost scales linearly.
